title: Aircrew briefing to Congress: not a false hit

tellings.quote: what do you think he meant when when u they brief Congress and says we knew it was not a false hit.

plain: Military aircrew who tracked an unexplained object in 2015 told members of the US Congress in a briefing that they knew it was not a false hit, meaning not a radar or sensor error. A commentator named Marik von Rennenkampff raises this in a debate episode with Michels, asking what the crew could have meant if not that something real was there.
